title: ObjectGenericDAE: data nodes and a postNewtonStepUserFunction
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.66.2 (#3158, #3143): nodeNumbersData of NodeGenericData; every user function gets the data coordinates x after y (after z for the constraint and Jacobian functions); postNewtonStepUserFunction(mbs, t, itemNumber, q, q_t, y, z, x, x0, parameters) returns [discontinuousError, recommendedStepSize, new x]; the system calls the post-Newton step of bodies, which it did for connectors only. Decided: yes, for discrete controllers, hysteresis and switching states of generic systems.
releaseNotes: ObjectGenericDAE has data nodes, nodeNumbersData: every user function gets the data coordinates x, and a postNewtonStepUserFunction updates them after each Newton iteration and returns the error of a switch and a recommended step size, e.g. for a discrete controller.
